scope: Body/scream observation to individual investigation; source comparison only
sourceIntent: Scream causes brief look/watch; body types distinguish own-group physical check from unknown-body observation and nearby-building memory.
Own-body check moves one actor, waits for real proximity or timeout/death, performs rearm/inventory collection, then returns to leader.
Assessment can use accumulated building memory, while suppression, STOP, stealth and hold-fire defer autonomous action.
actualCbePath: Engine HIDE body/scream cause may glanceAt known position for idle actor; no target identity disclosure.
Group assessment retains finite alerting response and prompt cadence, without treating body/scream as incoming-fire geometry or confirmed attacker.
CALM investigations consume known hostiles or SOUND/REPORT area reports; native body/scream response does not create that memory or an individual body-check operation.
gap: Individual body investigation and memory-driven follow-on are not implemented by a brief look. No whole-source parity credit.
disposition: Retain separation of alerting evidence from hostile knowledge and immediate physical hazard.
Build finite individual point investigation on owner/epoch/native-task/actor-reservation foundations; do not repurpose cover-away movement or send whole squad merely to reuse group investigation.
Use bounded local discovery only if physical corpse identity is needed; no allDeadMen world scan.
Treat inventory/rearm/launcher/backpack transfer separately with ammunition/loadout/mission-authority balance. No automatic raw upstream inventory mutation copied.
Actual position visit, cancellation, no-progress, original deadline and guarded continuation are required; flags or guessed corpse identity cannot count as physical success.
